public.releaseNotes:
3.9.0 — A much simpler EEON
• One screen, one button: today's meetings, your tasks, your latest notes, and Record
• Calendar keeps the range you pick — Today, This Week, or This Month
• Notes open into a clean list with search, Favorites, and Archived
• Each note now shows the tasks EEON pulled from it, with one-tap completion
• Tasks got a single options menu and a faster list
• Settings regrouped into six short sections; your name can be edited inline
• Fixed transcription failures that could save an empty note
public.description:
EEON is not a transcription app. It's your AI memory.

Press Record and talk. EEON turns rambling voice into clean notes, tasks synced to Apple Reminders, and meeting context pulled from your calendar. Ask EEON anything later: "What did I decide about pricing?" It remembers so you don't have to.

SAY IT ONCE

"Remind me to send Lena the pricing deck by Friday at five. Marco said the onboarding copy is done. We decided blue, not coral, for the icon."

EEON turns that into a clean note, a decision filed under the right context, and "Send Lena the pricing deck" in Apple Reminders. Nothing falls through the cracks.

ONE SCREEN, ONE BUTTON

- Today's meetings from your calendar, your open tasks, your latest notes, and Record
- Record from the Action Button, Control Center, Lock Screen, Siri, widgets, or the app
- Import a recording, type a note, or add a link or document
- Every note shows the tasks EEON pulled from it, with one-tap completion

NOT JUST TRANSCRIPTION

Most voice note tools stop at a transcript or summary. EEON builds a working memory from what you said:

- Decisions
- Action items
- Commitments
- People
- Projects
- Topics
- Questions and follow-ups

Then ask it in plain language:

- "What did I decide about pricing?"
- "What follow-ups do I owe Lena?"
- "What came up in last week's product meetings?"
- "What bugs did I mention while walking?"
- "Summarize what I said about the launch."

MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO THINK OUT LOUD

- Quick thoughts while walking or driving
- Meeting notes and standups
- Product decisions and launch context
- Customer calls and follow-ups
- Journal entries, brain dumps, and personal reflection
- Tasks you do not want to forget

BUILT FOR THE APPLE SYSTEM

- Sign in with Apple; notes sync through your private iCloud
- Meeting notes get the event title and attendees from iPhone Calendar or Google Calendar
- Action items land in an EEON list in Apple Reminders
- Optional: connect Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor to read your EEON memory, read-only, only after you authorize it

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Your notes are stored on your device and sync through your private iCloud account. Audio and text may be sent to AI services for transcription and note enhancement. EEON does not use your notes to train models.

FREE TO START

Record and transcribe for free. EEON Pro unlocks unlimited AI notes, formats, and the full memory.

- EEON Pro: $9.99 per month or $79.99 per year, auto-renewing
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
- Terms of Use: https://eeon.com/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://eeon.com/privacy

Say it once. EEON remembers.

attributes.whatsNew:
3.10.0 — Your notes, in your AI agents
• New: Settings → AI agents. Turn it on and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Claude can read your notes, read-only
• Connect a computer in seconds: scan its QR code with EEON and tap Allow. No passwords or keys to copy
• Send to an Agent: one tap on any note copies a ready prompt for your AI tool
• Calendar: tapping an event no longer starts the video call. Join from the call button instead

attributes.description:
Your personal AI assistant for iPhone.

Use the phone in your pocket as private memory for ideas, decisions, meetings, reminders, project context, and AI agents. No extra recorder. No pairing. No folder setup. Press record, talk naturally, and EEON turns your voice into clean notes, tracked actions, and searchable memory you can ask later.

SAY IT ONCE

"Remind me to send Lena the pricing deck by Friday at five. Marco said the onboarding copy is done. We decided blue, not coral, for the icon."

EEON can turn that into a clean note, a decision filed under the right context, and "Send Lena the pricing deck" in Apple Reminders.

BUILT FOR THE APPLE SYSTEM

- Record from the Action Button, Control Center, Lock Screen, Siri, or the app
- Sync notes through your Apple account with private iCloud and CloudKit
- Use Apple Calendar context so meeting notes can get the event title and attendees
- Send action items to Apple Reminders when you say "remind me"
- Use widgets and shortcuts so capture is always close
- Start free; no extra hardware, Bluetooth pairing, or third-party recorder account required

NOT JUST TRANSCRIPTION

Most voice note tools stop at a transcript or summary. EEON builds working memory from what you said, so compatible AI workspaces can search the context you captured after you authorize access:

- Decisions
- Action items
- Commitments
- People
- Projects
- Topics
- Questions and follow-ups

Your notes become a memory you can search in plain language:

- "What did I decide about pricing?"
- "What follow-ups do I owe Lena?"
- "What came up in last week's product meetings?"
- "What bugs did I mention while walking?"
- "Summarize what I said about the launch."

MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO THINK OUT LOUD

Use EEON for:

- Quick thoughts while walking or driving
- Meeting notes and standups
- Product decisions and launch context
- Customer calls and follow-ups
- Journal entries and personal reflection
- Tasks you do not want to forget

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Your notes are stored on your device and sync through your private iCloud account. EEON uses Sign in with Apple and the Apple services you already trust. Compatible AI workspaces, including MCP clients, can read your EEON memory only after you authorize an EEON connector; your phone remains the capture point and your Apple account remains the sync layer.

Audio and text may be sent to AI services for transcription and note enhancement. EEON does not use your notes to train models.

Record and transcribe for free. EEON Pro unlocks unlimited AI notes, formats, and the full memory.

- EEON Pro: $9.99 per month or $79.99 per year, auto-renewing
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

attributes.whatsNew:
3.8.3 — Calendar keeps working when Google sign-in expires
• When your Google Calendar sign-in expires, EEON now shows a clear Reconnect button instead of a technical error message
• Your iPhone Calendar meetings keep showing while Google needs reconnecting, instead of leaving the day blank
• Settings now tells you when Google Calendar needs to be reconnected
• Fixed a case where a working Google Calendar connection could be lost while saving
